title.en: Jasper Marketing AI: Seats, Credits and Brand Governance
title.zh: Jasper 营销 AI：席位、Credits 与品牌治理
title.cn: Jasper 营销 AI：席位、Credits 与品牌治理

content.en: Use Jasper when a marketing team needs reusable brand context, governed workflows and repeatable campaign production rather than another general AI drafting tab. Compare the one-seat Pro plan with custom Business contracts, shared credits and the real editing work required.
content.zh: 当营销团队需要可复用品牌上下文、受治理工作流和可重复活动生产，而不只是另一个通用 AI 起草窗口时，可考虑 Jasper。应比较单席位 Pro、定制 Business 合同、共享 credits 以及真实人工编辑成本。
content.cn: 当营销团队需要可复用品牌上下文、受治理工作流和可重复活动生产，而不只是另一个通用 AI 起草窗口时，可考虑 Jasper。应比较单席位 Pro、定制 Business 合同、共享 credits 以及真实人工编辑成本。

detail.en:
Choose Jasper when the decision is about a governed marketing-production system rather than access to a general language model. Jasper combines Canvas, Chat, Agents, Studio, Grid and Jasper IQ around reusable brand, audience and product context. That scope can help a marketing team coordinate repeatable work, but it also adds setup, governance and review work. Keep these capabilities under one Jasper canonical page rather than treating each named workspace feature as a separate product. [Pricing and platform scope](https://www.jasper.ai/pricing) · [Knowledge Base](https://help.jasper.ai/hc/en-us/articles/18618707176347-Knowledge-Base).

Pricing checked September 20, 2026: Pro is USD 69 per month per seat on monthly billing or USD 59 per month per seat billed yearly, includes one seat and offers a seven-day trial. Pro currently lists two Brand Voices, five Knowledge assets and three Audiences. Business uses custom pricing, generally starts with a 12-month commitment and adds more users, unlimited IQ customization, custom agents, Grid, API access, SSO and governance. Do not present USD 59 as flexible monthly billing, and do not invent a Business price from the Pro seat rate. [Current pricing](https://www.jasper.ai/pricing).

Business costs can include a second meter. Jasper documents a shared workspace credit pool for API and MCP calls, Grid output rows, Research and Optimization Agent runs, GEO Hub and GEO Agent actions, while core Chat, Agents, Studio and IQ remain included. Business workspaces receive base credits and can add prepaid packs or pay-as-you-go overage. Prepaid credits expire at renewal or a contract-defined date. All users can spend credits by default; admins can disable spending and set monthly user and workspace limits. The help center says changes to overage settings are not currently captured in the audit log. [Credits-based pricing](https://help.jasper.ai/hc/en-us/articles/46644376016923-Credits-Based-Pricing).

Brand controls need to be tested, not assumed. Brand Voice analyzes up to eight text examples, files or URLs and can be private or visible to the workspace. Pro includes two voices, while Business lists unlimited voices and adds Style Guides. Administrators can set a workspace default, but users can override it. Test whether approved vocabulary, prohibited claims, tone, product facts and audience context survive across several campaign formats; count corrections instead of judging a polished demo. [Brand Voice](https://help.jasper.ai/hc/en-us/articles/18618693085339-Brand-Voice).

Data commitments also have scope. Jasper's EULA says Jasper and third parties may not use Customer Property to train AI models used by the service, but authorized providers can still access and process Customer Property. It also distinguishes de-identified Usage Information from Customer Property. Customers submitting personal data for processing are directed to execute the DPA, and default hosting may include the United States, EEA or United Kingdom unless otherwise agreed. Verify the actual contract, sub-processors, deployment and retention rather than treating a trust page as proof of account configuration. [EULA](https://www.jasper.ai/legal/eula) · [DPA](https://www.jasper.ai/legal/dpa) · [Sub-processors](https://www.jasper.ai/legal/sub-processors) · [Trust](https://www.jasper.ai/trust).

Human review remains necessary. Jasper's ethics material describes AI as assisting rather than fully automating content creation. Brand context can reduce drift but cannot guarantee factual accuracy, legal compliance, original claims or publication-ready output. Define an approval owner for product claims, regulated language, citations and campaign release. [Ethics](https://www.jasper.ai/ethics).

Independent evidence supports a real buyer decision but shows different perspectives. G2 reports roughly 1.3 thousand Jasper reviews and strong satisfaction around brand workflow, while Trustpilot reports more than 4 thousand reviews with a 3.2 score and recurring complaints about generic drafts, heavy editing, cancellation, renewal and refunds. Review platforms are not controlled tests; use the disagreement to design trial exit and quality checks. [G2](https://www.g2.com/sellers/jasper) · [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.jasper.ai).

Run the seven-day Pro trial with a real brief, approved source facts and a defined brand rubric. Compare Jasper with the team's existing general AI assistant on setup time, accepted first drafts, correction minutes, claim accuracy, voice consistency and total seat-plus-credit cost. Confirm cancellation before the trial ends if the evidence is weak. The Ja artwork on this page is an AI Best Tool editorial identifier, not Jasper's official logo or a product screenshot.
detail.zh:
当采购问题是“是否需要受治理的营销生产系统”，而不是“能否使用一个通用大模型”时，可以考虑 Jasper。它把 Canvas、Chat、Agents、Studio、Grid 和 Jasper IQ 与可复用的品牌、受众和产品上下文结合起来。这有助于营销团队协调可重复工作，但也会增加配置、治理和复核成本。这些能力应归入一个 Jasper canonical 页面，而不是把每个 workspace 功能拆成独立产品。[价格与平台范围](https://www.jasper.ai/pricing) · [Knowledge Base](https://help.jasper.ai/hc/en-us/articles/18618707176347-Knowledge-Base)。

2026-09-20 价格核验：Pro 月付为每席位每月 69 美元，年付折算为每席位每月 59 美元，包含一个席位和 7 天试用。Pro 当前列出两个 Brand Voices、五个 Knowledge assets 和三个 Audiences。Business 为定制价格，通常从 12 个月承诺开始，增加更多用户、无限 IQ 定制、custom agents、Grid、API、SSO 和治理能力。不能把 59 美元写成灵活月付，也不能用 Pro 席位价虚构 Business 价格。[当前价格](https://www.jasper.ai/pricing)。

Business 成本可能还有第二个计量器。Jasper 文档说明 API/MCP、Grid 输出行、Research and Optimization Agent、GEO Hub 和 GEO Agent 使用共享 workspace credit 池，而核心 Chat、Agents、Studio 和 IQ 包含在平台中。Business 含基础 credits，可增加预付包或 PAYG 超额；预付 credits 在续约或合同指定日期失效。默认所有用户都可消耗 credits，管理员可关闭权限并设置用户和 workspace 月度上限。帮助中心还说明超额设置变化目前不会进入 audit log。[Credits 计费](https://help.jasper.ai/hc/en-us/articles/46644376016923-Credits-Based-Pricing)。

品牌控制必须测试，不能假设有效。Brand Voice 可分析最多八个文本示例、文件或 URL，可设为私有或 workspace 可见。Pro 含两个 voices，Business 列出无限 voices 并增加 Style Guides。管理员可以设置 workspace 默认值，但用户仍可覆盖。应跨多个活动格式测试批准词汇、禁用声明、语气、产品事实和受众上下文是否保留，并记录修正次数，而不是只看精心准备的演示。[Brand Voice](https://help.jasper.ai/hc/en-us/articles/18618693085339-Brand-Voice)。

数据承诺也有明确范围。Jasper EULA 表示 Jasper 与第三方不得用 Customer Property 训练服务使用的 AI 模型，但授权服务商仍可能访问和处理 Customer Property；EULA 还区分去标识 Usage Information 与 Customer Property。提交个人数据进行处理的客户被要求签署 DPA，除非另有协议，默认托管可能包括美国、EEA 或英国。应核对实际合同、子处理商、部署和留存，而不能把 trust 页面当作账号配置证明。[EULA](https://www.jasper.ai/legal/eula) · [DPA](https://www.jasper.ai/legal/dpa) · [子处理商](https://www.jasper.ai/legal/sub-processors) · [Trust](https://www.jasper.ai/trust)。

人工复核仍然必要。Jasper 的 ethics 材料把 AI 定义为辅助内容创作，而不是完全自动化。品牌上下文可以减少偏移，但不能保证事实准确、法律合规、声明原创或输出可直接发布。产品声明、受监管语言、引用和活动发布都需要明确审批人。[Ethics](https://www.jasper.ai/ethics)。

独立证据支持真实采购决策，但呈现不同视角。G2 约有 1,300 条 Jasper 评论，并对品牌工作流显示较强满意度；Trustpilot 超过 4,000 条评论、评分 3.2，反复出现内容泛化、编辑量大、取消、续费和退款问题。评论平台不是受控测试，应利用这种差异设计试用退出和质量检查。[G2](https://www.g2.com/sellers/jasper) · [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.jasper.ai)。

建议在 7 天 Pro 试用中使用真实 brief、已批准事实来源和明确品牌量表，并与团队已有通用 AI 助手比较配置时间、首稿接受率、修正分钟、声明准确性、语气一致性及席位加 credits 总成本。如果证据不足，应在试用结束前确认取消。页面 Ja 图形是 AI Best Tool 自制编辑识别图，不是 Jasper 官方 Logo 或产品截图。
